name: PW Chatbot - Lead and Health API

parameters.content:
## Lead and health endpoints
**/webhook/alice-lead** (POST): validates name, email and consent, rate-limits, saves to the `pw_leads` data table (Data tables tab). Stores no chat messages.
**/webhook/alice-health** (GET): returns {status: ok}. Point UptimeRobot at it.
Publish this workflow, then set the frontend env vars VITE_N8N_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL and VITE_N8N_HEALTH_URL.
